◈ BUKHAM PLAY4D ADVENTURE · SPACE + TIME

A TORTOISE FOLKTALE, TOLD IN FOUR DIMENSIONS

SHELLBOUNDThe Sky Feast

Create your own hero — your name, girl or boy, even your own face. Choose your age: child, teenager, youth or adult, each with its own challenge and weapons. Play with Amara, Hadassah, Tehilah, Tiara, Tobi, Emeka, Dayo and Musa, invite your real friends, and wake the old trickster tortoise. Slip between Now and Story-time, solve drum riddles, dig for treasure, shop at the market and win back the feast in the sky.

  • Your hero your name, your face, 4 ages
  • Weapons staff, catapult, spear, idà sword
  • Monsters brutes, wisps, Greedlings roam
  • Friends add by code, invite to play
  • Chat with villagers, Papa, Mbe and friends
  • Dress up hair, clothes, face paint
  • Mbe rolls, sniffs out treasure
  • Market food, groceries, upgrades
  • Time Weave two worlds, one path
Inspired by the West African tale of how the tortoise got his cracked shell.Earlier editions: Skybound Run 3D · Classic 2D
